decision: Probe actual focused editable-field observations before choosing an ordinary-prefix presentation change. Do not implement an attribute-only workaround or turn unaccepted hints into document composition.
current_owner: ContextAdmissionReducer and WindowInteraction; the read-only hint view has no text authority
first_failed_transition: The owned typed prefix is published as native preedit. Chrome 155.0.8059.84 converts an explicit UNDERLINE_NONE span to a thin composition underline and adds a full composition underline when no spans exist. Its GTK context does not implement surrounding-text retrieval. LibreOffice's existing process uses the GTK3 VCL plugin; its actual observation behavior has not been measured yet.

alternatives.reason: Chrome supplies the same full-prefix default underline when no remaining span exists. This cannot establish plain-prefix acceptance.

alternatives.option: Publish prefix and unaccepted hint as one native preedit
alternatives.reason: A client-forced commit may insert the hint. This violates the existing split between display and acceptance. Do not weaken its guard tests.

alternatives.option: Use ordinary committed input only where a fresh actual client snapshot supports the existing contracts
alternatives.reason: This preserves one owner and existing edit/output paths. First prove a usable observation source, field identity, sensitivity and stale-result rejection. Existing opaque-client policy stays unchanged until that evidence exists.

verification: Pending bounded remote-only native observation probe and Harness2 design review. No build, installation or new edit authority is authorized by a probe result alone.
not_tested: Ordinary-prefix rendering in Chrome/LibreOffice, browser inverse replay, a production accessibility source, GNOME and full matrices remain unaccepted. Kitty is user-confirmed working in this session and must be preserved.
